description.value: Mt Begbie Trailhead is the starting point for a steep, difficult hike to a backcountry campground and alpine viewpoint near Revelstoke, BC. Managed by BC Parks, it offers a rugged wilderness experience with dramatic mountain scenery. Touring cyclists exploring the Revelstoke area may find this a worthwhile side trip on foot.

raw_osm.description: Difficult (steep) hike to a backcountry campground and viewpoint.
raw_osm.name: Mt Begbie Trailhead
